channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump's search for Army secretary gains momentum as possible candidates surface
item.description: Sean Parnell and Brian Mast are among those mentioned as potential replacements for Dan Driscoll, following reported disagreements with Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Ken Paxton tells Newsmax: Texas voters not fully informed on Talarico
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton told Newsmax on Wednesday that Democrat James Talarico is running competitively in the traditionally Republican state.

item.title: GOP lawmaker's victim protection bill imposes lifetime restrictions on convicted predators
item.description: Rep. Abe Hamadeh's Kayleigh's Law, which passed the House unanimously, mandates lifetime no-contact orders for those convicted of sex crimes and violent felonies.

item.title: AOC endorses Florida Democrat Angie Nixon for U.S. Senate
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorses Florida state Rep. Angie Nixon, a Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate, who is running against a GOP opponent.
